package.name: prm_global_planner
package.description: PRM-3D multi-floor global planner. Loads per-floor 2D maps + a connections.json (topological union polygons), builds a fused multi-floor PRM roadmap offline, then plans from odometry to /goal_pose and publishes nav_msgs/Path to /global_path. Metric (x,y,z) is mapped to (pixel, floor_id) via a configurable resolution/origin and per-floor Z ranges.
